entry.sourceDescription: [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) is a ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS). [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has been written in Go programming language and has utilized Garble to obfuscate its code to target Windows environments. [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) is capable of executing its’ OS lockers in Windows, Linux, NAS, BSD and ESXi environments. [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) was first observed in mid-2025 as a closed ransomware and shortly later emerged as a RaaS to affiliates in September 2025.
